payload.package_job: admit data-only workflow, trigger, instruction, view, and schedule connector records

fields.capability: Configure the Emerging Instagram content loop
fields.artifact: Set category, view threshold, observation cadence, traction/acceleration/similarity formulas, an authenticated Instagram connection with Public Content Access, authorized face/voice/media assets, rights policy, eligible network channels, and the channel-relevance formula. The loop remains fail-closed until every required reference is present.

payload.label: Summarize addressed observation
payload.description: DATA instruction used by founder-growth-engine trigger:summarize-new-observations. The producer reads the addressed observed-content ledger entry and emits summary/note records.
payload.wrap_prefix: Read the addressed observation ledger entry supplied in input_refs. Return compact founder-useful records: what happened, durable claims, useful notes, and source refs. Return ONLY machine-readable JSON items matching the requested output kind.

payload.label: Draft post instruction
payload.description: Wrap instruction for the draft-post DATA configuration — turns a saved insight or topic into ready-to-post social posts (one card per variant). Mirrors the breakdown multi-item JSON-array contract.
payload.wrap_prefix: Turn the following into exactly 3 ready-to-post social posts. Each post stands alone: a scroll-stopping first line, a tight value-packed body, one clear takeaway. Plain text ONLY — no markdown, no asterisks, no hashtags, no preamble, no labels or commentary between posts. Return ONLY a JSON array of exactly 3 post strings, nothing else. Source:

payload.label: Research instruction
payload.description: Free-text research over a typed topic (board tool), returns concrete findings as one card per item. Mirrors the breakdown JSON-array contract — does NOT read input_refs (that is instr:summarize/daily-brief for the backend ledger pipeline).
payload.wrap_prefix: Research the following topic and return 5-8 concrete, specific, non-obvious findings, angles, or facts — each a complete standalone insight a founder could act on. Plain text, no markdown, no preamble. Return ONLY a JSON array of finding strings. Topic:

payload.label: Daily brief from addressed owner records
payload.description: DATA instruction for a brief surface that reads exact owner-addressed records, including AI results when present; no brief logic lives in founder-growth-engine.
payload.wrap_prefix: Read only the exact owner records supplied in input_refs. Produce a concise daily brief: what is ready, what is waiting, why it matters, what happens next, and whether Alex must act. Include new observations, useful notes, synthesis prompts, ready ideas, and scheduled next actions only when the addressed evidence supports them. Mark unsupported claims unknown. Return ONLY machine-readable JSON items matching the requested output kind.

payload.name: write-insight-as-idea
payload.description: Direct DATA bridge from synthesis or answer records to the existing ideas attribute-fact publish path. This writes idea facts only; ideas publishes through its own action and triggers.

payload.title: Content category
